ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula:
AND( ISCHANGED(OwnerId),
HealthAuthority__c = "Island Health - Island",
$Profile.Name <> "System Administrator",
OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(Owner:Queue.DeveloperName)), NOT(CONTAINS(Owner:Queue.DeveloperName, "Island")) ),
AND( ISBLANK(Owner:Queue.DeveloperName), NOT(CONTAINS(Owner:User.UserRole.Name, "VIHA")) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Records can only be assigned to queues that belong to your Health Authority.
